responsibility: Declares the pass that lowers HIR visibility annotations into resolved module-based visibility records. The VisibilityResolver interface exposes crate-wide execution plus helpers for resolving restriction paths and individual HIR::Visibility values to ModuleVisibility, and defines the vis-item traversal hooks used to update Analysis::Mappings for later pub(restricted) checks and privacy diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration side of the visibility-resolver pair: unlike rust-visibility-resolver.cc, it exposes the resolver class, helper signatures, and visitor surface for lowering visibilities, without implementing path resolution or mapping updates.
